H7 territory contract: file ownership, plan-section territory, commit protocol for hard-mode single-phase dispatch (also applicable to parallel dispatch)

Depth-first phase-closure contract: close one phase entirely before opening the next, order remaining phases cheapest-closure-first, stop at a closed phase boundary rather than opening a phase that cannot finish; applies in BOTH standard and hard mode

Per-item pre-edit verification gate: cheap, blast-radius-proportionate evidence (reference count, build probe, definition lookup) required before applying any item from a mechanically-generated list; failed probes route to Reasoned Exclusions; applies in BOTH standard and hard mode
H9 wrap-up and handoff contract: orchestrator handoff JSON schema, continuation markdown, incremental commit discipline
